title.narrative: Integrated food assistance and disaster preparedness for vulnerable populations in Hudur, Afmadow and Qanxas Dheere districts in Somalia

description.narrative: To mitigate the impact of projected below average rains and La Nina conditions, WFP plans to implement an integrated project providing conditional cash assistance coupled with dissemination of early warning information to pastoralist and agropastoral households in high-risk locations of Hudur, Afmadow and Qansax Dheere districts in Somalia. The project will aim to; i) protect livelihoods of vulnerable populations prone to the impact of dyer than usual conditions, including households' food and income sources; ii) reduce humanitarian needs; and iii) prevent new population displacement. To achieve this, WFP will provide 2,750 households (16,502 beneficiaries) with 3 months of cash assistance conditional to the construction or rehabilitation of critical community infrastructure, such as water harvesting structures. This will support food security, while strengthening the resilience of communities to climatic shocks, mitigating displacement and reducing the impact of La Nina conditions on community livelihoods. Activities will be co-designed with the target communities, ensuring an inclusive and collaborative approach. This will be coupled with dissemination of early warning information to targeted communities to enhance awareness and preparedness for drought. Key messages will be co-created and disseminated in collaboration with key partners including Government and development actors. Early warning information will strengthen community capacity to anticipate and manage the risk of drought.To ensure a rapid response, WFP will leverage its existing operations and capacities in the target locations and surrounding areas to ensure effective and timely implementation within the rapid response timeframe. Strong coordination with local authorities, the Food Security Cluster and cooperating partners, will enhance synergies across interventions, minimizing duplication of assistance and supporting a multi-sectoral approach. The project will complement and create linkages with other ongoing and planned humanitarian interventions in the target locations, including relief and nutrition.
